intro.title: Flexibility
paragraphs: Your dream is to become a successful entrepreneur and create a business that brings people together.
You have just been hired by a large multinational company where people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions work together.

Today you enter the R&D Room, where the team is facing a serious challenge. The client has just changed the requirements, and the main development software is down. This is the perfect moment to test your Flexibility.

dialogues.greet: Hello! We're facing a serious challenge. The client has just changed the requirements, and our main development software is down. This is the perfect moment to test your Flexibility.
dialogues.findStickyNote: Flexibility isn't just about changing plans. It's about managing stress and finding new solutions quickly. During the last R&D meeting, I wrote the key characteristics of a flexible mindset on a sticky note — but I lost it in this mess. Can you find it? Start by checking the table.
dialogues.stickyNoteFound: Great! As you can see, flexibility allows R&D teams to react quickly when experiments fail or requirements change. It helps us survive and stand out. Let's see if you understand the basics.
dialogues.quiz1Done: You understand the concept. Now we need to apply it to our R&D challenge.
dialogues.findPaper: Earlier today, I threw away an old development plan because it was too rigid. On the back of it, I had written a checklist on how to develop flexibility. I tossed it in the trash bin. Go retrieve it!
dialogues.paperFound: Excellent. This checklist will help us navigate uncertainty. But first, you must face some challenges.
dialogues.puzzle2Intro: Solve these problems to prove you are ready to lead.
dialogues.finalWords:
Perfect! You stayed calm, adapted, and acted proactively. That's the essence of flexibility in R&D.

Remember: staying open to change and continuously learning new tools will strengthen your confidence. You're ready for the next challenge!
dialogues.default: Keep looking around the room for clues.

dialogues.busy: The latest system update broke our prototype simulation! I need to focus on fixing this code. Talk to Elena about the development schedule.

trueFalse.title: Flexibility Basics – True or False
trueFalse.instructions: Determine if each statement is True or False.

questions.text: Research in neuroscience proves that flexibility is located in one specific center of the brain.
questions.hint: Neuroscience shows flexibility is a complex skill, not limited to a single brain area.

questions.text: Employees who are flexible and feel productive tend to have less stress and higher job satisfaction.
Flexibility is only about changing your vacation plans or everyday routines.
questions.hint: In the workplace, flexibility means responding effectively to change.

feedback.wrong: That's not quite right. Think about it again.
feedback.correct: Well done! You understand the basics of flexibility.

trueFalse.answerOverlay:
The correct answers are:
1. FALSE – Flexibility is a complex skill, not limited to one brain area.
2. TRUE – Flexible employees tend to have less stress.
3. FALSE – Flexibility extends far beyond everyday routines.

singleChoice.title: Challenges & Solutions Quiz
singleChoice.question: You feel anxious about a new R&D software update because you don't know how to use it (fear of the unknown). What is the best solution?

options.a: Avoid using the software until the old system returns.
options.b: Focus on skill development to prepare for the change.
options.d: Ask a colleague to do your work.

feedback.wrong: That's not the best approach. Preparation and learning reduce fear.
feedback.correct: Correct! Skill development is the best way to overcome fear of the unknown.

singleChoice.answerOverlay: The correct answer is: Focus on skill development to prepare for the change.

sequenceOrder.title: Handling the Unexpected
sequenceOrder.instructions: A sudden project delay occurs due to a leadership change. Arrange the steps to handle the situation flexibly.
items: Adjust your schedule and reprioritize critical tasks.
Discuss options with the team to choose the best scenario.
correctOrder: Discuss options with the team to choose the best scenario.
Adjust your schedule and reprioritize critical tasks.
hints: Step 2: Build a strategy with your team.

feedback.wrong: That's not the right order. Remember: recognize, strategize, manage time, then act.
feedback.correct: Excellent! You handled the unexpected situation with flexibility.

sequenceOrder.answerOverlay:
The correct order is:
1. Acknowledge the unexpected situation calmly.
2. Discuss options with the team.
3. Adjust your schedule and reprioritize.
4. Execute the new plan confidently.

hints.talkToElena3: Return to Elena with what you found.
hints.default: Look around the R&D room for clues.

systemDialogues.selfTalk: You enter the busy R&D room. The whiteboard is covered with crossed-out plans and revised timelines. Something serious is going on here. You notice Elena, the project lead, reviewing changes near the whiteboard.
systemDialogues.clickLaptop: Just Marco's code. Nothing about flexibility here. Maybe check under the coffee cup?
systemDialogues.foundStickyNote: You found it! A sticky note was stuck to the bottom of the cup.
systemDialogues.clickWhiteboard: These are outdated research milestones. They no longer apply. Look for the trash bin.
systemDialogues.foundPaper: You found the strategy! Return to Elena.

popupContent: Quick Responses: Respond immediately to market changes and customer demands.
Adaptive Philosophy: Immediately redefine needs and identify new opportunities.
Alternative Options: Find new ways to deal with technological development and uncertainty.
Improve time management: Prioritize tasks to adapt to new data.
Adopt a new mindset: Be open to change and continuous progress.
Be proactive: Be ready for changes rather than waiting for them to happen.
Embrace innovation: Be open to using cutting-edge tools and technology.

completion.title: Congratulations!
completion.message: You've completed the Flexibility skill! You stayed calm, adapted, and acted proactively. That's the essence of flexibility in R&D. You're ready for the next challenge!
